headline: Ashby Falls and Harlow Creek moved up a rating
summary: **3 of the 300 contracts changed overnight and 2 moved up a rating: Ashby Falls Water and Sewer, from 2 to 3; Harlow Creek WWTP, from 2 to 3.** Red Mesa rose inside its rating.

seen_not_scored.text: Positions open over 60 days, overtime above 13% and a second missed sample in a quarter: five of the seven sites that received a notice of violation since 2024 showed all three 8 to 12 weeks before.
